findings.text: asserts the unquoted scope finding "changed paths outside the write scope: docs/plan.html"; the landed quoting emits "docs/plan.html" quoted, so this test is red at the reviewed head and would be red on main once merged.

asserts the unquoted scope finding for an undeclared review path; the landed change quotes each stray path, so the emitted finding carries surrounding double quotes and this assertion fails at the reviewed head.

plan section 21's deliverable says a joined item splitting into several 'existing or declared' paths is reported as a list reading, but _is_space_separated_scope_item requires every part to lie within the declared scope, so a joined list of existing yet undeclared paths is still refused as one quoted stray.

the 29-file head arm stops at 38% with no EXIT line, so the done_when's full-population head result is quoted from an overwritten run rather than recorded in a readable log; the 9-file matched arms are complete and clean.
